entities.name: PMID:27497320
observations: In a multisite CHARTER structural-MRI cohort of 233 HIV-positive participants, voxel-based morphometry found smaller left ventral posterior cingulate gray-matter volume in those with distal neuropathic pain versus those without; peak P=0.017, t=5.15, MNI x=-6, y=-54, z=20.
Higher distal neuropathic-pain intensity was also associated with smaller volumes in cortical gray-matter regions involved in pain processing.

entities.name: PMID:36207560
observations: In 57 male HIV-seropositive patients, diffusion imaging found greater neuropathy severity correlated with lower white-matter integrity in thalamocortical radiations and superior bilateral cingulum; it did not directly test ventral posterior cingulate gray-matter volume or cortical thickness.

entities.name: HIV-DNP VPCC volume
observations: Direct association: HIV-associated distal neuropathic pain was associated with smaller left ventral posterior cingulate gray-matter volume on voxel-based morphometry.
The evidence is observational and supports association, not causation.
